name: platform-matrix
source_reference: User brief: white-background station whose large central structure performs 1-to-b, 2-to-a style route reassignment
brief: Warm-white field. A large near-black station block sits between four incoming and four outgoing platform lanes. Colored endpoint pairs appear at different vertical positions on each side, implying deterministic reassignment inside the station.

semantic_review.notes: The hidden permutation is communicated through displaced paired endpoints rather than visible spaghetti crossings.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: preserve one dominant station block, four platform channels, and paired endpoints in different vertical order
must_preserve: paired signals change order across the station
must_not_add: text, numbers, grid labels, circuit pins, shadows, gradients, or small mechanical detail

spec_constraints: two cobalt circles and two amber rounded squares at reordered positions

acceptance_checks: reads as a station or matrix switch rather than a microchip

composer.reason: four flat platform channels as opaque overlays
one clean vertical station spine binds the platform levels
paired signals make route reassignment visible without labels
